posts.heading: September 21, 2026
posts.text:
The day closes with 116 total visits and 19 species, a noticeably quieter picture than the recent weekly average of 230 visits. While Tufted Titmice and Carolina Chickadees continued to dominate the feeders, the lower traffic marks a distinct shift from the heavier counts seen in the earlier parts of this week.

The last visual record came from a Tufted Titmouse, observed just twenty-one minutes before sunset. This follows a steady late-day presence by Carolina Wrens and Gray Catbirds.
